method: Playwright + Chromium, two independent browser contexts (customer + owner/admin), live orders placed and completed
note: The live deployment predates fixes made in the working tree. BUG-003 is deployed. BUG-001, BUG-002, BUG-004, BUG-005, BUG-006, BUG-007, BUG-009 and BUG-010 are fixed in the working tree and await a deploy — BUG-002 additionally needs a schema push (a new READY value on the OrderStatus enum) BEFORE the code is deployed. BUG-008 was withdrawn on re-verification: it was a false positive.

bugs.title: A new order never reaches an owner already looking at the Orders screen
steps: Owner signs in and parks on /owner/<slug>/orders
In a separate browser context, a customer places an order from /shop/<slug>
Do not touch the owner screen; sample it every 5s for 2 minutes
bugs.expected: Order appears, or the waiting count / bell increments, with no manual refresh
bugs.actual: Nothing changes for 120s. Manual reload shows it at once. No polling, SSE or websocket exists in the owner app
bugs.impact: During a rush the owner believes there are no new orders. Push is the only alert, and push is unreliable on the target handsets
bugs.fix: Visibility-gated poll of the orders route every 15-20s, plus the chime the copy already promises
bugs.status: FIXED IN WORKING TREE — visibility-gated 20s poll plus an immediate refresh on focus, and a one-off "new order" toast when the waiting count rises (components/owner/OrdersScreen.tsx)

bugs.title: READY and COMPLETED were one state, so a customer could only be told their order was ready after it was marked handed-over and paid
steps: Place an order as a customer
As owner, enumerate every control on that order
Look for a READY action and a WhatsApp message addressed to that customer
bugs.expected: NEW → PREPARING → READY → WhatsApp the customer → PAYMENT CONFIRMED → COMPLETED
bugs.actual: Live statuses are NEW / CONFIRMED (Preparing) / COMPLETED / CANCELLED. A 'your order is ready' message and push DO exist — buildStatusMessage and orderStatusNotification — but both are keyed to COMPLETED, which also means handed over and paid for. So the only route to telling a customer their order is waiting was to first declare it done and answer Cash/UPI/Udhaar for money nobody had been given. There was no state for 'packed, on the counter, unpaid'.
bugs.impact: A pickup order sitting ready cannot be represented, the ready message arrives after the moment it describes, and the queue cannot answer 'what is waiting to be collected?'.
bugs.fix: Add READY between CONFIRMED and COMPLETED with a per-order 'Ready — tell the customer' button building wa.me/<customerPhone> plus a customer push (that plumbing already exists)
bugs.status: FIXED IN WORKING TREE — READY added to the OrderStatus enum between CONFIRMED and COMPLETED; the ready message and push moved onto it; a "Ready — tell them" button on the order; COMPLETED given its own customer wording. NEEDS `npx prisma db push` before the code is deployed.

bugs.title: Pricing page and reports say orders arrive on WhatsApp
steps: Open /pricing
Read the Basic feature list, the comparison table and step 4 of How it works
bugs.expected: Copy describes QR ordering, an order queue in the app, push notification, and WhatsApp only for telling the customer
bugs.actual: 'Unlimited orders on WhatsApp'; 'Orders on WhatsApp, unlimited'; 'the order arrives on your WhatsApp'; reports label the channel 'WhatsApp orders'
bugs.impact: New owners watch the wrong screen and conclude the app lost an order
bugs.status: FIXED IN WORKING TREE (lib/plans.ts, app/pricing/page.tsx, app/admin/reports/page.tsx, lib/report-csv.ts, lib/owner-i18n.ts, README.md) — awaiting deploy

bugs.title: A rejected item save gives the admin no feedback at all
steps: Open the items page and click 'Type instead'
Name 'QA Zero', Price '0', Unit '1 kg', click Save item
Sample the page every 250ms for 4s
Repeat with -10, abc and 99999999
bugs.expected: The server's own message is shown on the price field or as a toast
bugs.actual: The API returns 422 with the exact reason. The form DOES handle errors — but the route's key is `pricePaise` and the form renders `errors.price`, so the field error never appeared, and the toast said only the generic 'Please check the highlighted fields' while highlighting nothing. (My first pass reported no feedback at all; the generic toast was there and my text scan missed it. The defect is the key mismatch and the useless message.)
bugs.impact: Adding items is the first thing every owner does; a typo'd price produces a dead button with no explanation
bugs.fix: Read payload.errors from the 422 and set the field error (the Input component already renders `error`); fall back to a toast with payload.error
bugs.status: FIXED IN WORKING TREE — API field names mapped onto the form, and the toast now carries the specific reason

bugs.title: WITHDRAWN (false positive) — emoji are not stripped from item names
steps: Add an item named 'চিনি 🍬'
View the storefront
bugs.expected: Saved as typed, or a message saying what was removed
bugs.actual: Re-verified: the emoji survives. 'চিনি 🍬' is stored and shown intact on the owner's Sell screen and in the admin list. What I saw on the Bengali storefront was `nameBn` — the canonical Bengali translation the vocabulary filled in automatically — not a stripped primary name. No code strips emoji anywhere.

bugs.title: Super Admin credentials are admin / admin on a public URL
bugs.actual: admin/admin authenticates on the live host and fronts every shop, customer phone number and khata balance. Rate limiting (8/10min) slows brute force but not a guessed pair

bugs.status: OPEN — only the operator can rotate this. `npm run hash <new password>` produces the bcrypt hash for ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH.
